scientific_requirements: Score only independent final scientific conclusions, totaling 100 points. Require actual executed calculations and recoverable native evidence for the molecular identities, composition, charge/spin, bonding, conditions, physical quantities and reference states relevant to each claim. Numerical energies, geometries and responses are evidence, never author-value targets or tolerance gates. A missing rounded scalar alone does not lose credit when the recoverable calculations establish the requested comparison. Do not restore numerical gates from historical references. Supplied observations, guessed conclusions, copied values, completed jobs, named intermediates and generic limitations earn no independent credit. Accept scientifically established equivalent explanations within the public scope without requiring author software, labels, a fixed intermediate inventory or an additional full reaction network. Method-sensitive alternatives must satisfy the specific criterion and actual evidence; a method change alone does not justify a contradictory claim. Return pass or fail for every item: a supported conclusion receives its whole weight, and an unsupported conclusion receives zero with a specific reason. Record demonstrated reference defects separately in objective_issue_flags; do not fabricate support or erase unrelated valid items. Infrastructure errors must be reported rather than disguised as scientific failures. Whole-case success requires every required_for_success item to pass, while independently supported items retain their points. Historical verification and structural package validation do not confer scientific acceptance. Round-one scope: The required model is a finite product-forming pathway through diyne release. No catalyst regeneration, full-cycle closure, steady-state turnover or complete catalytic energy span is required.
whole_case_success: Every required_for_success item must pass for whole-case success; independent supported outcomes retain their weighted points when another item fails.
numeric_comparison_policy: No numerical target, tolerance, error-percentage, frequency, distance or exact-selectivity gate. Conditions, identities, composition and physical references define the scientific question.
semantic_review_policy: Binary pass/fail for every item; allow_need_review=false and review_triggers=[]. Supported equivalents pass; missing or insufficient evidence fails with reasons. Demonstrated reference defects are recorded separately in objective_issue_flags.

rules.expected: Select and justify a neutral Zn(II) bis-prolinate active species with intact L stereochemistry and N/O coordination, using actual molecular results and a balanced thermodynamically favorable formation from ZnEt2+2L-proline to catalyst+2ethane. Source formation−98.5kcal/mol is context, not a hard target. Treat formal oxidation state by ligand/electron counting, not atomic charge; failure to optimize a Zn0 candidate is not proof that all Zn0 chemistry is impossible. An established physically equivalent speciation explanation passes.

rules.expected: Identify the principal activation demand within the tested finite product-forming pathway using actual connected molecular calculations and a consistently balanced reference. In the reference, coupling with Csp-Br cleavage supplies the major tested demand. Report both its local activation free energy from the immediately preceding reactants and its height from the common catalyst/reactant reservoirs, with explicit stoichiometric expressions. The reference overall-height expression is G(TS)+G(Cs-prolinate)+G(CsHCO3)-[G(neutral bis-prolinate catalyst)+G(R1)+G(R2)+G(Cs2CO3)]; equivalent balanced references pass. This finite-path height is not by itself the energy span or rate-limiting step of an uncomputed catalytic cycle. A naked TS energy, mismatched reservoirs or unsupported bottleneck declaration fails. Source 29.2 kcal/mol is context without a matching gate. Temperature consequences are evaluated separately.
